name: First-order partial correlation
definition: r_xy·z=(r_xy−r_xz r_yz)/√[(1−r_xz²)(1−r_yz²)], for sample Pearson correlations on a common set of observations.
variables: r_xy,r_xz,r_yz sample Pearson correlations; z control variable; r_xy·z residual linear correlation
assumptions: Aligned observations, nonconstant variables, nonsingular residual variances; inferential use requires a separately justified sampling model.
limitations: Controls only linear association with the specified covariate; does not establish causal effects or general conditional independence.
failure_conditions: Perfect correlation with control variable or inconsistent pairwise samples
computation: Calculate all correlations on the same complete cases and evaluate the formula, equivalently correlate residuals from separate regressions on z with intercepts.
application: Describe remaining linear association after accounting for a prespecified measured covariate in development data.
required_inputs: Three aligned numeric variables on common authorised observations.
incompatible_methods: Interpreting residual association as a causal effect

name: Bartlett correlation-matrix sphericity test
definition: For p≥2 variables and n independent observations, B=−[n−1−(2p+5)/6] ln det(R), where R is the sample correlation matrix.
variables: n sample size; p variable count; R positive-definite sample correlation matrix; B approximate chi-square statistic
assumptions: Multivariate normal independent observations; n>p, positive definite R, adequately large sample; null population correlation matrix equals identity.
limitations: Sensitive to departures from normality and large sample sizes; rejects global identity, not a specific association or factor model.
failure_conditions: Singular correlation matrix or unjustified independence
computation: Compute sample correlation matrix, stable log determinant and correction factor; use approximate chi-square reference with p(p−1)/2 degrees of freedom.
application: Assess global linear dependence structure in a prespecified set of development measurements.
required_inputs: Authorised complete aligned multivariate numeric data with adequate sample size.
incompatible_methods: Using a singular or pairwise-deletion correlation matrix without adjustment
